publication_name: Composite leading indicator, G20, amplitude adjusted, OECD harmonised
access_description: OECD SDMX API on sdmx.oecd.org. No API key. Registration is voluntary. One monthly G20 series, format=csvfilewithlabels, dataflow version 4.1.
auth_requirement: No API key. The terms say registration is encouraged but not required and does not change the terms.
conditions: Rights pending. The series is not registered for refresh. An earlier local insert remains because observations are append-only and are not treated as operational. Except where a dataset metadata source tab states third-party ownership or extra restrictions, cite the OECD. This row is only the G20 series whose calculation methodology label is OECD harmonised. Do not store a national CPI or the Eurostat HICP from this publisher under this row.
revision_behaviour: The CSV is the current series, not a historical vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Official gaps are omitted and are not stored as zero.
unresolved_questions: The terms do not name AI processing or model training. The user remains responsible for any third-party material that a later edition labels as restricted.
evidence_note: Section 3 of the OECD terms states: Except where additional restrictions apply, you can extract from, download, copy, adapt, print, distribute, share and embed Data for any purpose, even for commercial use. You must give appropriate credit to the OECD. The same section says an API may be used to facilitate access and that registration is encouraged but not required. The response calculation methodology is OECD harmonised and the measure is Composite leading indicator (CLI), amplitude adjusted, unit Index. A non-persisting fetch on 2026-10-24 contained 789 monthly observations from 1961-01 to 2026-09, one value per month. It is not a historical vintage panel. The stored class is latest-revised. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume this dataset id. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000.
